notes: §2002:14.8.20.3 GR3: INITIATE on a never-opened report file sets EC-REPORT-FILE-MODE and takes no action (PAGE-COUNTER preset 7 stays 7; the following TERMINATE raises EC-REPORT-INACTIVE per §2002:14.8.42.3 GR1), while OPEN OUTPUT and OPEN EXTEND let INITIATE set PAGE-COUNTER to 1 with no exception. The --std 2002 run of g2-initiate-file-mode matched the derived output.
